facts.statement: Fossils of Chilenosuchus were discovered in the El Bordo Formation in the Antofagasta Region of northern Chile.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found in the El Bordo Formation, in the Antofagasta Region in northern Chile.

facts.statement: Researchers have proposed that Chilenosuchus belongs to the clade Typothoracisinae alongside Typothorax and other similar aetosaurs.
facts.quote: It has been proposed to be a member of a recently devised clade, Typothoracisinae, along with Typothorax and several other similar aetosaurs.

facts.statement: The exact position of Chilenosuchus within the family Stagonolepididae remains uncertain due to a lack of substantial material.
facts.quote: the position of Chilenosuchus within Stagonolepididae will remain uncertain until more material can be found.

facts.statement: A 2003 reevaluation confirmed that Chilenosuchus lived during the Triassic period.
facts.quote: a reevaluation in 2003 upon the relocation of the material showed that it was in fact an aetosaur and that the strata were of Triassic age.

facts.statement: Chilenosuchus lived from the Carnian to the Rhaetian stages, approximately 237 to 201.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Rhaetian (237 to 201.4 million years ago)

facts.statement: Chilenosuchus appears closely related to Typothorax based on similarities in their armour plating.
facts.quote: Based on similarities in the armour plating, Chilenosuchus seems to be closely related to Typothorax.

facts.statement: There was initial controversy regarding the age of the strata containing Chilenosuchus fossils, as plant and invertebrate fossils suggested a Carboniferous or Early Permian age, which conflicts with the known appearance of aetosaurs in the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: The presence of Chilenosuchus in the beds that it was found in conflicts with the inferred age of the strata.

rejected.statement: The genus Chilenosuchus was described by Casamiquela in 1980.

rejected.statement: Chilenosuchus is an extinct genus belonging to the aetosaur group.
rejected.quote: Chilenosuchus is an extinct genus of aetosaur.
